visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video begins with a medium shot of a young woman with dark, shoulder-length hair wearing a grey long-sleeved sweater. She holds a transparent plastic bin filled with various makeup products, smiling and gesturing with her hand toward the camera in a brightly lit indoor room. (2) She presents a white and blue tube of sunscreen, pointing at it before applying dots of the white cream onto her forehead and cheeks, blending it in with her fingers using smooth, upward motions. (3) The scene cuts to her holding a small concealer wand; she applies three dots under each eye and then uses a small white makeup sponge to gently pat and blend the product into her skin. (4) She brushes her eyebrows with a spoolie brush, then holds up a black eyebrow powder palette with three shades, using a small brush to fill in her brows with focused expressions. (5) She shows a purple tube of brow gel to the camera, then brushes it through her eyebrows, demonstrating the 'before' and 'after' effect by leaning closer to the lens. (6) A four-shade eyeshadow palette in a black case is displayed; she uses her fingertip to apply a pinkish shade to her eyelids, followed by a brush for blending around the brow bone and eye sockets. (7) She holds a white eyelash container and uses silver tweezers to carefully attach individual false eyelashes to her upper lash line, looking into a hand mirror. (8) She presents a round, pink blush compact with a gold logo and a large makeup brush, applying the pink powder to the area just below her eyes and across her cheekbones. (9) In the final phase, she poses for the camera, touching her chin and gesturing toward her face to showcase the completed makeup look, smiling warmly with a soft pink lip color.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A friendly female voice begins with a rapid greeting over a light, upbeat synth-pop BGM. A subtle digital 'pop' sound effect accompanies the opening title text. (2) The narration shifts to describing the sunscreen; the voice is clear and articulating perfectly. The BGM remains steady with a cheerful piano melody and a soft electronic beat. (3) As the concealer is mentioned, a quick 'whoosh' transition SFX plays. The speaker's pitch rises slightly to emphasize the product's effectiveness. (4) For the brow powder section, the vocal pace remains brisk. A faint mechanical click or UI sound effect triggers as the brand name appears on screen. (5) During the brow gel application, the voice becomes more descriptive and persuasive. The BGM maintains a consistent loop. (6) A bright chime or UI notification sound plays as the eyeshadow palette is revealed. The narration sounds increasingly enthusiastic. (7) The speaker's tone becomes more focused as she explains the eyelash application; the BGM lowers slightly in volume to keep the focus on the voice. (8) High-pitched excitement is audible as the blush is shown. A subtle swoosh SFX marks the brush movement. (9) The audio concludes with a high-arousal sign-off and a final digital stinger SFX as the music fades out quickly.
